headline: Blazen build
title: Blazen Best Build | Lightning Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Blazen is a Lightning Break unit, so stack Break. Its two skills are Electrified Impact and Lightning Cross. Electrified Impact dashes at the target and cannot be blocked during the dash. Lightning Cross adds fifty percent crit rate. Equip the Gargantuan Horn, which adds extra Break every level, and aim for an ENTP personality. Do you use Blazen as your breaker? Comment below!
description: Blazen best build in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Electrified Impact and Lightning Cross, Break priority, Gargantuan Horn, ENTP personality.
